scope: 233 original development manifest entries plus bounded independent review; no runtime data.

transform_rules.match: tmp pytest root plus home basename

aggregate_rule: SHA256 UTF-8 canonical JSON of files and generated_files; sort_keys=True, separators comma/colon, ensure_ascii=False
path_rules: Captured .patch and .diff become .patch.log and .diff.log; raw whitespace unchanged.
